newsitem.title: USA: Sparta Surgical gets Nasdaq exception.
newsitem.headline: Sparta Surgical gets Nasdaq exception.

text.p: Sparta Surgical Corp said Thursday its common stock will continue to be listed on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market through an exception to the market's $1.00 minimum bid price requirement.
The exception expires on March 28, it said.
Thomas Reiner, Sparta's president, told Reuters the company is planning a one-for-six reverse split of its common stock on March 27.
That action, he said, would raise Sparta's stock price to above the minimum required.
In its announcement, Sparta said while it believes it can meet the Nasdaq conditions to meet the requirement, there can be no assurance that it will do so.
It said that if in the future the companay's securities should cease to be listed on the Nasdaq SmallCap market, they may continue to be listed on the Over-the-Counter Bulletin Board.
For the duration of the exception, it said its trading symbol will be changed to SPSGC.O.
